transcript.text: bosch 24 not draining, water sitting in bottom. help

I can help. “24” may be part of a model/series rather than a fault code, and the drain checks differ between a dishwasher and washing machine. Is it a Bosch dishwasher or washing machine? If you can, send the full model number from the label as well.
dishwasher. model SMS24AW01G. display shows E:24

E:24 on this Bosch means it has not been able to drain. The usual cause is a blocked filter, debris caught around the drain-pump impeller, or a kink/blockage in the drain hose—not necessarily a failed pump. 1. Switch the dishwasher off and unplug it. Remove the lower basket, twist out the filter and rinse it thoroughly. Sponge or cup out the standing water first, then look into the sump beneath the filter with a torch. Food labels, glass, bones and grease are common obstructions. 2. If there is a small removable pump cover in the sump, carefully unclip it and check for trapped debris. Gently try the impeller with a finger; it should move, though it may feel slightly stepped. Use gloves if there may be broken glass. A jammed impeller points to an obstruction; a clear sump and freely moving impeller makes the hose/waste connection more likely. 3. Check the drain hose behind the machine and under the sink for a squash or sharp kink. Also make sure the sink is draining normally; a blocked sink trap or waste connection can prevent the dishwasher emptying. 4. Refit the cover and filter securely, then run Cancel/Drain or a short rinse programme. If it drains after cleaning, run a normal wash to confirm it stays clear. If the filter, sump, hose and sink waste are all clear but it remains full of water, the drain pump or its wiring becomes more likely and an engineer is the sensible next step.
ok. filter was blocked with food and a bit of broken glass. cleaned it, now drains fine and E:24 gone. wore gloves? no, will next time

For prevention, clear the filter regularly and scrape plates well before loading. If you ever find glass again, switch off and unplug first, then use gloves or a brush/tongs rather than fingers. If E:24 returns despite a clean filter, the next places to check are the sump/pump area and drain hose.
[Helpful to see: image "Where the filter is" — The filter sits in the base of the dishwasher, usually under the bottom spray arm. Twist it out anticlockwise and rinse it under a tap. Typical layout — your dishwasher may differ.]
